bullets.title: Exhalation: Stories
bullets.creator: Ted Chiang
bullets.note: . I’ve previously recommended Ted’s incredible collection of short stories titled [_Stories of Your Life and Others_](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/rnt8hoh7eozrx6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9TdG9yaWVzLVlvdXItTGlmZS1PdGhlcnMtQ2hpYW5nL2RwLzExMDE5NzIxMjIvcmVmPXNyXzFfMT9rZXl3b3Jkcz1TdG9yaWVzK29mK1lvdXIrTGlmZSthbmQrT3RoZXImcWlkPTE1NjkzNTAxODMmcz1ib29rcyZzcj0xLTE=). Despite the fact that Ted started off as a part-time science-fiction writer with a full-time technical writing job, he is the equivalent of Martin Scorsese or Wayne Gretzky in the sci-fi world—he has won four Hugo, four Nebula, and four Locus Awards, among others. The hit film [_Arrival_](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/84cqhoh3x7nv97/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9BcnJpdmFsLUFteS1BZGFtcy9kcC9CMDFNMkM0TlA4L3JlZj1zcl8xXzE_a2V5d29yZHM9YXJyaXZhbCZxaWQ9MTU2OTM1MjA0OSZzPWdhdGV3YXkmc3I9OC0x) ([94% on Rotten Tomatoes](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/l9sehmh4zd79rp/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucm90dGVudG9tYXRvZXMuY29tL20vYXJyaXZhbF8yMDE2)), one of my favorite movies of the last 3–5 years, is based on [one of Ted’s short stories](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/d7aeh0hkm2ng53/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvU3Rvcnlfb2ZfWW91cl9MaWZl). Gizmodo [has written that](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/79b7h8h8mx573v/aHR0cHM6Ly9pbzkuZ2l6bW9kby5jb20vdGhpcy1uZXctdGVkLWNoaWFuZy1zaG9ydC1zdG9yeS1jb3VsZC1jaGFuZ2UteW91ci1saWZlLTE0NTI0NjU0NjU=) “the arrival of a new piece of short fiction by Ted Chiang is always cause for celebration and parades and wild dancing.” [_Exhalation_](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/vkh3hrh4dqr7g9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9FeGhhbGF0aW9uLVN0b3JpZXMtVGVkLUNoaWFuZy9kcC8xMTAxOTQ3ODg4Lw==), his newest collection, may be even better than his last. It’s just so damn good.

bullets.section: What I’m installing a second time —
bullets.title: Enclume Premier 36-Inch Rolled End Bar
bullets.note: Check out [this photo](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/k2imh6he3ovq4e/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9wL0IybTNkQVBuTEdwLw==) to see what it looks like installed in my kitchen. As I said in the caption: “Some of the most useful things in my house are the simplest. Example: this Enclume 36" rolled end bar from Amazon. This is the second time I’ve installed one, and it immediately cleared two drawers. Tip: arrange the pans from smallest to biggest to make finding what you need faster.” The keen eye may notice that they don’t seem perfectly ordered by size in my pic. That’s because I first order by material (e.g., cast iron) and then order by size within each material. Yes, I’m a nerd making the most of OCD.

His work is simply mesmerizing, and you can [see beautiful examples here](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/9wczhnhxlermnl/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9kYW5pZWxwb3BwZXIv). I have so many faves, but [this is one](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/4osvheh9n78ek0/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9wL0JqcTRreU1sdzh0Lw==). If I had a bit more backyard—or a resort, retreat center, big garden, etc.—I’d put his art all over the place. More of his pieces can be found [on his official website](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/k0udre388b6hlqpzqio/rga8hoh7eozrn0/aHR0cDovL3d3dy5kYW5pZWxwb3BwZXIuY29tLw==).
